description: This file defines the interface for a STUN client within the 'stun' namespace, including classes, enums, and functions related to STUN message creation, encoding, decoding, and network discovery, specifically for the NetworkManager plugin context.

classes.name: attribute
classes.description: Represents a STUN attribute with type, length, and value.

classes.name: attributes::address
classes.description: Base class for address attributes, encapsulating sockaddr_storage.

classes.name: attributes::mapped_address
classes.description: Derived class representing a mapped address attribute.

classes.name: attributes::source_address
classes.description: Derived class representing a source address attribute.

classes.name: attributes::changed_address
classes.description: Derived class representing a changed address attribute.

classes.name: message
classes.description: Represents a STUN message with header and attributes, capable of encoding and attribute lookup.

classes.name: message_factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating specific STUN messages, e.g., binding request.

classes.name: decoder
classes.description: Provides static methods to decode various parts of a STUN message from a buffer.

classes.name: encoder
classes.description: Provides static methods to encode data types into a buffer.

classes.name: server
classes.description: Represents a server with hostname and port for network communication.

classes.name: bind_result
classes.description: Stores the result of a binding operation, including the public IP address.

classes.name: client
classes.description: Implements a STUN client capable of binding, discovering network type, and managing socket communication.

methods.name: create_binding_request
methods.description: Creates a new STUN binding request message.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Performs a binding operation to discover network address translation details.

methods.name: discover_network_access_type
methods.description: Discovers the type of network access (e.g., NAT type) using STUN.

methods.name: send_binding_request
methods.description: Sends a STUN binding request, optionally to a specific address.

methods.name: send_message
methods.description: Sends a generic STUN message to a remote address.
